verdict.rationale: The firm has a documented Patent Counseling & Prosecution group page describing drafting/prosecuting patent applications and portfolio counseling for clients from startups to Fortune 100s, satisfying the core of the story. However, missing for 10: no named individual practitioner bios/attorney profiles are cited, no mention of specific technical domains or patent portfolio strategy depth, and no independent corroboration (rankings, case studies) of prosecution outcomes.
